text: Following the January 24, 2024 North York Community Council meeting, the owner has advised that they did not see the Notification until after the meeting.

North York Community Council: 1. Re-opened Item NY10.22, titled 31 Norden Crescent - Application for Fence Exemption. 2. Directed that this Item be considered at the next North York Community Council meeting April 2, 2024 and that Notice be issued in accordance with Municipal Code Chapter 447, Fences.
